content:
The Hisilicon ISP (Image Signal Processing) GDC (Geometric Distortion Correction) feature is a technology used in image processing. It is designed to correct geometric distortion in an image that results from the lens, ensuring the image appears as realistic and accurate as possible.

This feature automatically corrects curved lines, distortions, and other anomalies in an image that can occur during the image capturing process. It is particularly useful in enhancing image quality in devices like cameras, smartphones, and other imaging devices.  

By implementing GDC, images taken with wide-angle and fish-eye lenses can be converted into standard perspective images while maintaining high resolution. This technology is crucial in various fields such as photography, surveillance, and autonomous driving applications.
